CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_ddl_watch()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  cmd record;
BEGIN
  FOR cmd IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands()
  LOOP
    IF cmd.command_tag IN (
      'CREATE SCHEMA', 'ALTER SCHEMA'
    , 'CREATE TABLE', 'CREATE TABLE AS', 'SELECT INTO', 'ALTER TABLE'
    , 'CREATE FOREIGN TABLE', 'ALTER FOREIGN TABLE'
    , 'CREATE VIEW', 'ALTER VIEW'
    , 'CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW', 'ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW'
    , 'CREATE FUNCTION', 'ALTER FUNCTION'
    , 'CREATE TRIGGER'
    , 'CREATE TYPE', 'ALTER TYPE'
    , 'CREATE RULE'
    , 'COMMENT'
    )
    -- don't notify in case of CREATE TEMP table or other objects created on pg_temp
    AND cmd.schema_name is distinct from 'pg_temp'
    THEN
      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END; $function$
ddl_triggers.name: pgrst_ddl_watch

ddl_triggers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_drop_watch()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  obj record;
BEGIN
  FOR obj IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects()
  LOOP
    IF obj.object_type IN (
      'schema'
    , 'table'
    , 'foreign table'
    , 'view'
    , 'materialized view'
    , 'function'
    , 'trigger'
    , 'type'
    , 'rule'
    )
    AND obj.is_temporary IS false -- no pg_temp objects
    THEN
      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END; $function$
ddl_triggers.name: pgrst_drop_watch

function.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.trg_reassign_org_customer_lifecycle()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_customer_ids bigint[] := array_remove(
    array[old.customer_id, new.customer_id]::bigint[],
    null
  );
  v_product public.org_organization_product%rowtype;
  v_history public.org_organization_product_history%rowtype;
  v_order public.aka_order%rowtype;
  v_order_history public.aka_order_history%rowtype;
begin
  if old.customer_id is not distinct from new.customer_id then
    return new;
  end if;

  for v_product in
    select product.*
    from public.org_organization_product as product
    where product.organization_id = new.id
    order by product.id
  loop
    v_customer_ids := coalesce(v_customer_ids, '{}'::bigint[])
      || private.sync_org_product_customer_lifecycle(v_product);
  end loop;

  for v_history in
    select history.*
    from public.org_organization_product_history as history
    where history.organization_id = new.id
    order by history.id
  loop
    v_customer_ids := coalesce(v_customer_ids, '{}'::bigint[])
      || private.sync_org_product_history_customer_lifecycle(v_history);
  end loop;

  -- SQL/manual orders with no direct customer use the organization link as a
  -- fallback. Recompute both current and append-only order evidence when that
  -- link moves; org_product mirror orders remain excluded by the sync helper.
  for v_order in
    select order_row.*
    from public.aka_order as order_row
    where order_row.organization_id = new.id
      and order_row.customer_id is null
      and order_row.source_system in ('sql_account', 'legacy_manual')
    order by order_row.id
  loop
    v_customer_ids := coalesce(v_customer_ids, '{}'::bigint[])
      || private.sync_aka_order_customer_lifecycle(v_order);

    for v_order_history in
      select history.*
      from public.aka_order_history as history
      where history.aka_order_id = v_order.id
      order by history.id
    loop
      v_customer_ids := coalesce(v_customer_ids, '{}'::bigint[])
        || private.sync_aka_order_history_customer_lifecycle(v_order_history);
    end loop;
  end loop;

  perform private.refresh_aka_customer_lifecycle_projections(v_customer_ids);
  return new;
end
$function$

triggers.name: trg_reassign_org_customer_lifecycle

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_sync_organization_orders AFTER UPDATE ON org_organization FOR EACH ROW WHEN (old.* IS DISTINCT FROM new.*) EXECUTE FUNCTION private.trg_sync_organization_orders()

function.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.trg_sync_organization_orders()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_product_id bigint;
begin
  for v_product_id in
    select product.id
    from public.org_organization_product as product
    where product.organization_id = new.id
    order by product.id
  loop
    perform private.sync_org_product_to_aka_order(
      v_product_id,
      'organization_update'
    );
  end loop;
  return new;
end;
$function$

triggers.name: trg_sync_organization_orders
